verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers skill installation, plugin metadata, and Ledger task CLI operations (create, filter, mark, archive, dependency ordering), but nothing documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or any event-subscription mechanism. Because the skills drive the YYLO Ledger and CLI tooling, webhooks are a fair question for this kind of product, so missing evidence means none, not na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
